messages.text: BL-1834 🎵 in progress — The Work-note gate counts every ticket-naming commit on the role's HEAD since the note was created, so the coordinator's own 'Promote <id>' and 'BL topic record for <id>' commits, made seconds after the dispatch and merged in from main, read as the role's work - on 2026-09-30 the coder completed the Work notes for BL-1830, BL-1833 and BL-1816 back to back with nothing built and went idle, stranding three active tickets (coordinator note 013867) - a commit reachable from main is never a role's work evidence
